title: india_lp Curriculum Crosswalk Record
description: A pointer from an official Indian curriculum/standards document (NCF, a state syllabus) to machine-readable curriculum-graph data that already exists elsewhere in this ecosystem -- ConceptBase/CompetencyBase records, bio-core-k12/interdisciplinary-k12 LPM strands. This is deliberately NOT a document archive: state/<state>/lp/ and national_ccs_policy/lp/ hold metadata ABOUT how far a crosswalk has progressed, not the standards content itself. Modeled on deutsche_lp's/nys_lp's curriculum-crosswalk-record.schema.json; sourceSystem is adapted since no India-specific live queryable standards endpoint has been found as of this repo's founding session -- see nys_lp's own equivalent finding for the same reason (no FWU-MEM-SPARQL-style service confirmed to exist for India either).

standardOrFramework.description: What this crosswalk covers, e.g. 'NCF 2023 Science, Secondary Stage', 'Karnataka State Curriculum Framework, Biology'. A crosswalk record is scoped to one standard/framework document.

sourceSystem.description: 'openevo-conceptbase-competencybase-informal-refs' = this ecosystem's own ConceptBase/CompetencyBase records, loosely referenced. 'published-standards-doc-no-live-api' = the official published document itself (PDF/web page), not a live queryable API. 'not-yet-available' = no machine-readable crosswalk exists yet.

sourceRepoPath.description: Relative path to the actual data file in a sibling repo. This repo references that file; it does not copy its contents in.

coverageStatus.description: How far the referenced data has progressed, mirroring deutsche_lp's/nys_lp's own three-tier progression convention.

licenseOrRightsNote.description: The legal/rights status of the referenced external dataset itself (not this record, which stores no source text). Mirrors OpenLPM's standards_documents.license_or_rights_note field (openlpm migration 019) for ecosystem-wide naming consistency. accessTier does not apply to this schema since it deliberately stores no excerpt/full text.
